text: Scrapes and returns structured results from the Google search results page.
quote: Our Google Search API allows you to scrape results from the Google search page.

text: Lets you localize searches by specifying a real-world location down to city level.
quote: It is recommended to specify location at the city level in order to simulate a real user’s search.

text: Choose output format as structured JSON, raw HTML, or LLM-optimized markdown.
quote: Parameter defines the format of the result. It can be set to `json` (default) to get a structured JSON of the results, `html` to get the raw HTML retrieved, or `md` to get a markdown-formatted version optimized for LLMs and AI agents.

text: Google News topic tokens let you pull news results for specific topics like World, Business, Technology.
quote: Parameter defines the Google News topic token. It is used for accessing the news results for a specific topic (e.g., "World", "Business", "Technology").

text: ZeroTrace Mode prevents storage of search parameters, files, or data once a search completes.
quote: With ZeroTrace Mode enabled, we don't store your search parameters, files, or data. Once a search completes, it's as if it never happened.

text: Official Python client lets you run a search with parameters and get results as a dict.
quote:
search = GoogleSearch({"q": "coffee", "location": "Austin,Texas", "api_key": "<your secret api key>"})
result = search.get_dict()

text: Legacy client library is being deprecated in favor of a newer serpapi-python package.
quote: This package will soon be **deprecated** in favor of [serpapi-python](https://github.com/serpapi/serpapi-python). We recommend migrating to the newer implementation to ensure continued support and access to the latest features and improveme

text: Automatic Early Renewal option triggers an early plan renewal once your searches are used up.
quote: You can set your plan to Automatic Early Renewal. It will trigger an early renewal once you've used all your searches.

text: Identical repeated searches are served free from a temporary cache instead of consuming paid quota.
quote: The search results are stored in a temporary cache. The previous search can be retrieved from the cache for free.

text: A fields parameter lets you select which output fields are returned to reduce payload size.
quote: Parameter defines the fields you want to include in the output, reducing payload size for faster response.

text: A U.S. Legal Shield covers legal costs for scraping/parsing search engine data, with up to $2M coverage on higher plans.
quote: Our U.S. Legal Shield covers the scraping and parsing of search engine data, as long as your use of the data or service is not illegal.

text: An async submission mode lets you fire off a search and fetch results later instead of holding a connection open.
quote: Parameter defines the way you want to submit your search to SerpApi. It can be set to `false` (default) to open an HTTP connection and keep it open until you got your search results, or `true` to just submit your search to SerpApi and retri

text: Supports standard Google search operators like inurl:, site:, and intitle: in queries.
quote: You can use anything that you would use in a regular Google search. e.g. `inurl:`, `site:`, `intitle:`.

text: Cached search results expire after 1 hour and don't count toward monthly search quota.
quote: Cache expires after 1h. Cached searches are free, and are not counted towards your searches per month.

text: A Searches Archive API lets you retrieve previously run search results later.
quote: you'll need to use our Searches Archive API to retrieve your results

text: Provides a public status page to monitor live API success rates and response times.
quote: Monitor SerpApi's live API success rates and response times.

text: Location parameter matching can resolve ambiguous city names to multiple specific locations.
quote: This prints the first 3 locations matching Austin (Texas, Texas, Rochester).

text: Provides a script builder tool to quickly generate integration code.
quote: SerpApi provides a script builder to get you started quickly.

text: A parameter lets you set the geographic origin point from which the search is performed.
quote: Parameter defines from where you want the search to originate.

text: Scrapes and returns results from the Google News search page.
quote: Our Google News API allows you to scrape results from the Google News search page.

text: Python package scrapes and parses search results from multiple engines including Google, Bing, Baidu, Yandex, Yahoo, Home Depot, and eBay.
quote: This Python package is meant to scrape and parse search results from Google, Bing, Baidu, Yandex, Yahoo, Home Depot, eBay and more
